result:
I've planned round 458 (decision: CONTINUE). Round 457 failed C, so it is a third try at the same test-only fix. The store tree is untouched; A applies the change next round.

**Round 457 result.** A stopped on a new Medium bug, A-R457-REVIEW-M1, and C reproduced it. The bug is in a test helper that maps which files the app actually loads. For an import like `'~/lib/u/'` or `'~/lib/u/index'`, it picked the file `lib/u.ts` instead of the folder index `lib/u/index.ts`. It could therefore report a used file as unused, and the safety check (LT9) stayed green. It does not affect the app today: there is one such file/folder pair (`lib/utils`) and nothing imports it that way. The gate was skipped and nothing was published. No item moved to done.

**My ruling (round 458 task):**
- **Measured, not assumed.** Vite and TypeScript resolve these imports differently: Vite sends `'./u/'` to the file, TypeScript sends it to the folder index. So for a trailing slash the helper now follows both; `/index` follows only the index; a plain import is unchanged.
- **Same class fixed together.** It also fixes the two related name-loss cases (P4b and P5) and the reviewer's Low #3, an underscore case that could also call a used file unused. A new test, LT10, pins all of them. The wrong sentence in doc 299 is withdrawn and A rewrites it.
- **Evidence on a scratch copy:**
  - the set of files the helper reaches is identical to round 456 (294), and no "unused" verdict changes;
  - 42 deliberately broken variants: all fail as expected, except the two control lines (BASE, C1), which stay green as they should;
  - full suite 284 files / 4152 tests, typecheck, lint (205 warnings, same as HEAD) and Biome all clean;
  - tech-lead approved the exact delta A will apply (sha `39839288`).
- **Stop-loss, so this doesn't become round 459.** Round 458 stops only if a newly found form actually appears in `app/` or changes a named verdict. Otherwise it is recorded as a Low and the round goes on to C. If a third Medium-class form turns up, I plan a separate task to replace the regex-based helper with one built on the TypeScript compiler. A script, `walker-forms.py`, counts the known risky forms; today every count is 0.

**Bookkeeping:**
- Round 457 archived as `tasks/round-457.md` (byte-identical copy).
- `backlog.json` is at version 450 (decisions D-29z1622 and D-29z1623). The new Medium is open with C's replay recorded as confirmation, and the new Lows are in `deferred_low_polish`.
- `feature-status.md`, `b-round-457.md` and `b-next.json` are updated.
- I asked root for a short, non-blocking `frontend-architect` review, since this is the third round in a row on the same helper (`b-round-457/checkpoint-request-addendum.md`).
- Advisor was available and I consulted it twice.

**Next:** the 3-day regression round is due when round 459 is planned on or after 2026-11-13. After it: SABA-B-13 (the Store entrance animation), the rest of STORE-2b, STORE-2c…5, ARCH-SPLIT, REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS and T12-ADVANCED.
